subject: Plant Compound Isoacteoside Engages Nuclear Receptors to Restart Neural Stem Cell Division
script: From Agewell Brief: Plant Compound Isoacteoside Engages Nuclear Receptors to Restart Neural Stem Cell Division. Researchers found that isoacteoside binds the TLX receptor in rats, prompting dormant stem cells to generate fresh neurons despite toxic amyloid accumulation. In the adult mammalian brain, producing new neurons relies on a reservoir of neural stem cells controlled by the orphan nuclear receptor TLX. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
